summary: SNDL Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer listed on NASDAQ and the CSE, furnished a Form 6-K on October 14, 2026, attaching a press release announcing only that it will report third-quarter 2026 financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026, before markets open on Tuesday, October 27, 2026. No transaction, stakeholder, or corporate action is disclosed; the release includes webcast and conference-call access details for 10:00 a.m. EDT that day. No board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms appear in this filing, which is a routine scheduling announcement.
